about: Fresh series ideas, three per series added every week. 'weeks' = The XXL Nail Diaries (s: can, qa, sets, dumps); 'perfumeWeeks' = Scent Diaries (s: ptest, ppair, pvan, pdump). Newest week last. t = title; h = hook; sh = shot list or slides; c = caption; tg = 5 hashtags; cta = call to action; f = format. Optional d = shoot date (YYYY-MM-DD); otherwise the app puts nails on Mon/Wed/Fri and perfume on Tue/Thu/Sat after the week's date.

ideas.t: Can I peel a clementine with XXL nails?
ideas.h: Clementine season vs. my XXL nails. Somebody's losing.
sh: A clementine on a clean counter, gold rings on, nails tapping the peel. Ask: "Can I do it?"
The attempt: one real-time close-up, going for a single long spiral of peel.
Verdict + hand a slice to the camera — Easy / Takes Practice / Not Happening.
ideas.cta: What should I peel next? Pomegranate is NOT an option 👇

ideas.t: Do you ever accidentally scratch people?
ideas.h: The question I get every single time I go in for a hug.
sh: Skit: go in for a hug with a friend, hands hovering dramatically, palms only.
Close-up: the knuckle-scratch and pads-only tuck-your-hair technique.
Talk to camera: the house rules (pads only, nails pointed out, hugs given with care).
ideas.c: Hugs are given with ✨care✨ Pads only, nails pointed out 💅
ideas.cta: Tag the friend who's scared to hug me 😂

ideas.h: Holiday season but make it XXL.
sh: Holding a festive coffee cup
Curling gift ribbon with a nail
Lighting a candle
Sweater sleeve + nails close-up
Ornament or twinkle-light close-up
Shopping bags in hand
Final: both hands framing a wrapped gift
ideas.c: Caption prompt: rate your holiday energy in one line + the set name. e.g. "Holiday mode: activated. Nails: XXL. 🎄💅"

ideas.t: Can I put on winter gloves with XXL nails?
ideas.h: Winter is here and my gloves were NOT designed for this.
sh: Gloves on the counter, nails tapping them. Ask the camera: "Can I do it?"
The attempt in one real-time close-up: finger by finger, no cuts.
Verdict + a cozy hands-in-pockets pose (or the gloves in defeat).
ideas.c: Winter gloves vs. XXL nails 🧤💅 Verdict: ___
ideas.cta: What winter thing should I try next? Scarf? Zipper? 👇

ideas.t: Chrome vs. velvet vs. glitter: picking my holiday XXL finish
ideas.h: Three finishes, one holiday set. Help me choose.
sh: At your appointment: hold up three swatch nails (chrome, velvet/cat-eye, glitter) in good light.
Slow tilt of each swatch so the finish catches the light, labeled 1, 2, 3.
Reveal which one you went with on the full XXL set + slow pan.
ideas.c: The holiday finish has been chosen ✨💅 Did I pick right?

ideas.t: How do you put on lotion with nails this long?
ideas.h: "How do you even put lotion on?" Like this, actually.
sh: Your body butter on the counter, close-up of the XXL set.
Demo: scoop with the back of a nail or a small spatula, then smooth on with palms and pads only.
Glowy arm + nails flex to camera.
ideas.c: Palms and pads do the work, the nails just look pretty 🤍💅
ideas.cta: What's the next everyday thing you want me to show? 👇

ideas.t: Bonfire test: can my vanilla beat the smoke?
ideas.h: Vanilla vs. a fall bonfire. Only one of us is leaving with our dignity.
sh: Spray before heading out — bottle + fire pit in frame.
Bonfire B-roll: s'mores, flannel, sparks (stay a safe distance back).
Next-morning sniff of your sweater + verdict overlay.
ideas.cta: What should my vanilla go up against next? 👇

ideas.t: Friendsgiving layering: vanilla + pear (soft enough for the dinner table)
ideas.h: A perfume combo that won't fight the turkey.
sh: Table setting + both bottles beside a place card.
One light spray of each — explain why soft scents win at dinner.
Toast moment, wrist close-up as you raise your glass.
ideas.c: Smell amazing, don't overpower the mac & cheese 🍐🍦
ideas.cta: What do you wear to holiday dinners?

sh: Vanilla latte in a cream mug
Bottle on a knit blanket
Candle lit beside the bottle
Fall leaves + bottle on the porch
Wrist spray with XXL nails
Cozy selfie with the bottle by the window
ideas.c: Caption prompt: "November smells like ___" — fill it in with your scent. e.g. "November smells like vanilla and leftovers 🍂🍦"
ideas.cta: Fill in the blank: November smells like ___ 👇

ideas.t: Vanilla vs. the bakery aisle: can anyone still smell me?
ideas.h: I wore vanilla into the bakery section. It's a fair fight.
sh: Spray in the car with a dramatic "we're going in" overlay.
Walk through the bakery aisle, then ask your shopping buddy to sniff-test you right there.
Parking-lot verdict with a cookie in hand.
ideas.cta: Where should my vanilla compete next? 👇

ideas.t: New to vanilla? Start with these 4 vanilla vibes
ideas.h: Not all vanillas are the same. Find your vibe first.
sh: Four of your bottles in a row, labeled: Sweet, Clean, Cozy, Sultry.
Spray each on a card with a one-line description of who it's for.
End with the vibe you're wearing today + wrist close-up.
ideas.c: Your vanilla era starts here 🍦 Which vibe are you?
ideas.cta: Comment your vibe: Sweet, Clean, Cozy or Sultry 👇

ideas.t: My vanilla scent stack: lotion, mist, then perfume
ideas.h: The order matters if you want to smell like this all day.
sh: Flat lay of your three steps in order: body butter, body mist, perfume.
Apply in order on camera: lotion first, mist over it, perfume on pulse points.
End-of-day sniff check + cozy sweater shot.
ideas.c: Layer it right and vanilla follows you all day 🤍🍦
ideas.cta: Do you layer your body care with your perfume?
